scripts.//typecheck: `next typegen` writes next-env.d.ts and .next/types, which tsconfig includes and which declare the image modules and typed routes. Both are git-ignored, so on a fresh clone or in CI they do not exist and `tsc` alone fails on `import mark from '…/rsskyler-mark.png'`. It works locally only because `next dev` happens to have written them already.
scripts.setup: npm run api:install && npm run admin:install && npm run api:migrate && npm run api:seed
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm --prefix admin run lint && npm --prefix admin run typecheck && npm --prefix api run typecheck
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run admin:build && npm run api:build
